description: Search Pexels for videos matching a query, with optional orientation/size/locale filters. Returns compact video objects with rendition links. Read-only. `video_files` is trimmed to the highest-resolution renditions (see `video_files_count` for the full count) — call pexels_get_video for the complete rendition list on one video.

locale.description: The locale of the search, e.g. "en-US", "fr-FR" (28 supported locales).

per_page.description: Items per page (clamped to a max of 80).

size.description: Minimum video size: large (4K), medium (Full HD), or small (HD).

name: pexels_search_videos
title: Search Pexels Videos
